COUNT DOWN Shuffling the deck in -- Days : -- Hrs : -- Min : -- Sec Registration Is Closed! Houston, Texas Sound on Welcome in! What is HackRice? HackRice is Rice University's annual hackathon. It brings together creators, developers, and designers together under one roof to develop & showcase their creative and entrepreneurial talents in an environment designed for collaboration. Teams of up to 4 form to attack real-world issues, building viable software or hardware solutions within a hyper-focused 36-hour sprint.
